summary: The main article describes a photodivergent strategy for the oxo- and hydroalkylation of vinyl arenes using 1,3-dicarbonyls, featuring 3 tables for reaction development and scope, and 6 schemes/figures detailing mechanisms and synthetic applications. The document also references supplementary crystallographic data for specific products.

items.heading: Graphical Abstract
items.caption: Controllable divergent reactivity of 1,3-dicarbonyls for hydro- and oxoalkylation of vinyl arenes.
items.description: A summary graphic showing the divergent pathways to oxoalkylated and hydroalkylated products and their synergistic use to form cyclopentanols.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Photodivergent ATRA: Mechanistic Blueprint
items.description: Outlines the theoretical pathways (a and b) for hydrofunctionalization versus oxofunctionalization based on the ability to reduce radical intermediates.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: Concept of Visible-Light-Induced Homolysis (Dissociative LMCT) of Cu(II)-Complexes
items.description: Illustrates the generation of radical species from Cu(II) complexes via light-induced ligand-to-metal charge transfer.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: Photodivergent Oxoalkylation and Hydroalkylation of Alkenes with 1,3-Dicarbonyls
items.description: Detailed mechanistic proposal showing the divergent pathways (Cu-catalyzed vs. 4CzIPN-catalyzed) and the synergistic [4+1]-annulation.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Reaction Development
items.description: Optimization table screening catalysts, bases, and atmospheres for both oxoalkylation and hydroalkylation pathways.

items.heading: Table 2
items.caption: Scope of the Oxoalkylation Process
items.description: Displays the variety of 1,3-dicarbonyls and vinyl arenes compatible with the Cu-catalyzed oxoalkylation conditions.

items.heading: Table 3
items.caption: Scope of the Hydroalkylation Process
items.description: Shows the substrate scope for the 4CzIPN-catalyzed hydroalkylation of various styrenes and malonates.

items.heading: Table 4
items.caption: Synergistic Photocatalysis: Synthesis of Cyclopentanol Derivatives
items.description: Presents the results of the sequential oxo- and hydroalkylation to form diastereoselective cyclopentanols.

items.heading: Scheme 4
items.caption: Gram-Scale Reactions
items.description: Demonstrates the scalability of both the oxoalkylation and hydroalkylation protocols on multi-millimole scales.

items.heading: Scheme 5
items.caption: Synthetic Transformations
items.description: Illustrates the conversion of reaction products into various heterocycles, diols, and antibiotic potentiators.

items.heading: Figure 1
items.caption: Mechanistic studies.
items.description: Includes radical trapping experiments, UV-Vis absorption spectra, and Stern-Volmer quenching data to support the mechanism.

items.heading: Scheme 6
items.caption: Divergent Photocatalysis: Work at a Glance
items.description: A concluding summary scheme highlighting the two catalytic manifolds and the resulting cyclopentanol synthesis.
